newsitem.title: USA: AOL unit in modem deal with U.S. Robotics.
newsitem.headline: AOL unit in modem deal with U.S. Robotics.

text.p: AOL Networks, a unit of America Online Inc, on Wednesday said it has entered into a deal with 3Com Corp's U.S. Robotics unit to deploy high-speed modem technology in AOL's network.
Financial details of the deal were not disclosed.

U.S. Robotics will supply its 'x2' modem technology to AOLnet, AOL's dial-up network. Using x2 technology, AOL members will be able to access the AOL service over telephone lines at speeds as high as 56 kilobits per second, up to two times as fast as current modems allow.
AOL Networks oversees the AOL consumer online network, which has more than 8 million members worldwide.
